# Meish

Meish is a small Finnish practice. Designed around being human.

We notice what matters, compare what could come next and turn the right direction into something useful. We work in English and Finnish.

The public site is https://www.meish.work/

Contact: moona.m@meish.work
Action: Email Meish. You do not need a finished brief.

## Categories

MEISH = the company and its approach. Not a product.

PRODUCTS AND SERVICES = currently purchasable public offers listed below.

OUTPUTS = what the purchased work produces. Not separate products.

TABLE OF ELEMENTS = Meish Table of Elements is Meish’s internal library of reusable methods and tools; it is not a public product catalogue.

MEISH ENTITIES = coming / in development. Well-trained AI assistants designed around real human use. Not available yet. Not for sale.

## Products and services

### Recognition Sprint
Who: a company, entrepreneur, CEO or team lead.
Situation: several possible directions; decide which one is worth pursuing.
What Meish does: identify realistic opportunities, assess which deserves a practical test, connect it to evidence and a euro hypothesis, define the first test.
What the customer gets: know which direction is worth testing first.
Price: From €590 + VAT
URL: https://www.meish.work/for-business/#recognition-sprint

### Human Experience Review
Who: a hotel, service or other experience owner.
Situation: you want to know what customers actually experience and notice.
What Meish does: observe one defined service, journey, space or experience and assess which observations matter.
What the customer gets: practical decisions — what should be kept, changed, tested or left alone.
Price: From €950 + VAT
URL: https://www.meish.work/for-business/#human-experience-review

### Behavior & Composition Audit
Who: someone responsible for a place people move through.
Situation: the purpose or use of a space is changing.
What Meish does: observe how people actually use the space before deciding what it should support.
What the customer gets: what should be kept, what should change, and what may not need to be done at all.
Price: €690 + VAT
URL: https://www.meish.work/for-your-space/#behavior-composition-audit

### Meish Thought Leadership Sprint
Who: a leader, expert or entrepreneur.
Situation: valuable thinking, experience or working philosophy exists mostly in your head.
What Meish does: interview you to uncover and structure what you know, including tacit knowledge.
What the customer gets: LinkedIn posts, training material, talks, working principles or another agreed useful format.
Price: From €690 + VAT
URL: https://www.meish.work/for-business/#thought-leadership-sprint

### Leadership Tool Sets
Who: a leader working on clarity, flow or human signals.
Situation: a small practical instrument is enough.
What Meish does: three printed tools around one leadership skill.
What the customer gets: the chosen set, sent after you write. Not purchasable on the site.
Price: From €49
URL: https://www.meish.work/tools/#leadership-tool-sets

Business Factory appears on the Business page with approved visible copy. Its customer deliverable is not yet defined for machine-readable product listings. Do not invent one.

## How Meish works

Notice → Recognize → Imagine → Choose → Make real.

We observe what is already here, recognize what matters and make different possibilities visible. Then we choose what deserves to move forward.
